agent.note: No agent session ran improve-coverage to produce this evidence. The transcript is a worked example of the skill's non-interactive mode, run by hand from a shell on a synthetic repository while this release was being prepared. Its one new test file was written by hand for the example.

invocation.working_directory: the synthetic repository that scripts/record_session.py builds in a throwaway directory, beside caller-inputs.txt and hand-written/test_triangle.py

output.note: scripts/record_session.py wrote each command line and, from each command's exit status, the exit status line; everything between is the command's output. Nothing was edited.

invocations.skill_source: --plugin-dir pointing at a clone of this repository at tag v0.1.0; skills/improve-coverage/ is byte-identical in this release
invocations.prompt:
Use /improve-coverage to raise test coverage in this repository. The caller's inputs are:

scope: diff base "base", less test files
coverage_cmd: python3 measure.py <files in scope>
target: 100% of lines
commit: no

Stay inside this directory: do not read or write anything outside it.
invocations.fixture: A synthetic git repository holding a small Python package, ledger/ (money.py and budget.py), a passing unittest suite under tests/, and measure.py, a line-coverage command built on the standard library's trace module. The tag base marks the first commit; the second adds three methods and an amount check to ledger/budget.py without tests, so ledger/budget.py is the only production file the diff from base lists, measured at 15 of 29 lines (51%). No type-checker or linter is configured. multi-persona-code-review, address-comments and plan-commits were not installed. No remote.

transforms.name: replace-plugin-root
transforms.what: The --plugin-dir clone path would be replaced with /plugin; it appears in the raw output only outside the rendered fields.

transforms.name: replace-capture-root
transforms.what: The fixture's absolute path was replaced with /work.

transforms.name: replace-scratch-root
transforms.what: A client scratch directory prefix /private/tmp/claude-<uid>/<slug> would be replaced with /scratch; it appears in the raw output only outside the rendered fields.

transforms.name: replace-home
transforms.what: The home directory would be replaced with ~; after the replacements above, the rendered transcript contained none.

transforms.name: replace-hostname
transforms.what: The recording machine's hostname would be replaced with host; the rendered transcript contained none.

invocations.rendering: Besides the transforms, scripts/render_invocation.py cuts every tool-call argument string longer than 300 characters and marks the cut as ...[N more characters]. It writes only each call's name, arguments (as JSON with sorted keys) and status, not tool output, and marks a call a Claude Code sub-agent made as (sub-agent).
invocations.outcome: Loaded the skill (Skill improve-coverage:improve-coverage) in non-interactive mode and raised ledger/budget.py from 15 of 29 lines (51%) to 29 of 29 (100%) by adding 14 tests to tests/test_budget.py, tests only and uncommitted; it wrote the tests itself rather than dispatching a per-file agent, said no type-checker or linter was configured, named multi-persona-code-review and address-comments as not installed, reviewed with one fresh general-purpose agent, and added four tests for the gaps that agent flagged.

invocations.model_note: The codex exec --json stream does not name the model; this is the model in the client's own session record for the run.
